entityDescription:
Or3it develops a no-code Earth Observation (EO) analytics platform that consolidates satellite imagery sourcing, AI-driven analysis, and enterprise integration into a single unified workflow environment. It is built on the LexaTexer AI analytics platform and extends proven industrial AI architecture into geospatial applications.
 
The core problem Or3it solves is structural fragmentation in satellite analytics. Organizations face difficult access to multi-provider imagery, inconsistent formats and APIs, high technical barriers to building analytics pipelines, non-repeatable manual workflows, and weak integration into operational systems. As a result, Earth Observation often remains experimental instead of becoming embedded operational infrastructure.
 
Or3it removes these barriers by providing unified access to optical and SAR satellite data, including high-resolution SAR for all-weather and day-night monitoring. The platform automatically harmonizes formats, preprocesses imagery, and applies AI-driven models such as vegetation forecasting, anomaly detection, change detection, and object classification.
 
A central component is the no-code workflow builder. Users can visually design, customize, and deploy repeatable geospatial analytics workflows without programming skills. Pre-built solution templates accelerate deployment across sectors. Results are delivered in integration-ready formats and can be pushed directly into GIS systems, ERP platforms, and decision-support environments.
 
Primary markets include agriculture and forestry, infrastructure and transportation, energy and utilities, defense and security, disaster management, finance and insurance, and maritime monitoring. Typical use cases include crop health monitoring, palm oil compliance auditing, vegetation encroachment detection along power lines, road condition monitoring, wildfire risk forecasting, and area-of-interest surveillance.
 
Or3it differentiates itself through full no-code usability, multi-provider satellite consolidation, scalable repeatable workflows instead of one-off analytics, and enterprise-grade system integration. Unlike traditional EO ecosystems where imagery vendors, analytics providers, and integration teams are fragmented, Or3it connects the full value chain from data acquisition to actionable decision output.

entityDescription:
The Nanoscience Laboratory(NL) at the Department of Physics, University of Trento,focuses on cutting-edge research in areas such as neuromorphic photonics, integrated quantum photonics, non-hermitian photonics, linear and nonlinear silicon photonics,and nanobiotechnologies. NL is dedicated to advancing our understanding of the fundamental physical phenomena involving photons and their interaction with matter—particularly when structured at the nanoscale.
NL explores a broad range of optical systems, including waveguides, microresonators, and complex dielectric structures, striving to bridge basic science with innovative applications.
NL's research spans the full spectrum from theoretical studies to practical device development,with a strong emphasis on photonic technologiesthat integrate seamlessly with modern silicon-based microelectronics. While silicon photonics is a key focus, the lab also investigates alternative materials such as cellulose for atomic-level nanostructuring. Additionally, NL explores the interface between photonics and biology,including studies on living neuron cultures, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in nanobiotechnology.

entityDescription:
Topologic Consulting was established in 2016 in Warsaw, Poland. The entity’s mission is connected with provision of expertise and solutions oriented on EO satellite monitoring and applications of spatial information for the needs of fulfilling needs of various sectors both private and public. Using the expertise in the field of data harmonisation, data processing, data fusion, capabilities of work with customers towards defining their needs allow for definition, design and development of solutions fulfilling customers’ needs in the most optimised way. The company provides consulting and advisory services. It also assists in R&D projects planning, coordination and conducting.
Topologic is involved in Geo4IRBM (Geospatial Information Support for Integrated River Basins Management) financed in course of the Polish Industrial Incentive Scheme Programme. Project results main beneficent is the Asian Development Bank team, located in Jakarta, Indonesia, which dealing with planning a multiannual water resources management-oriented loan project. During the Geo4IRBM Topologic designed and developed tools supporting assessment of water resources, water retention and consumption in agriculture. The tools are based on continuous satellite monitoring, mainly conducted with use of Sentinel-1 satellites. Topologic provided also land cover maps, cropping intensity maps, maps of potential erosion and sediment yield. Total area covered by monitoring tools and spatial products is 22,000sqkm.
Besides physical geography-oriented works, Topologic conducts also human geography and geomarketing oriented activities. Long term cooperation with the Institute of Geography and Spatial Management of Polish Academy of Sciences in Warsaw required adaptation and development of transport modelling techniques as well as methods of fusion of spatial and statistical data aiming at research of small towns societies and economic factors.
Topologic is an Agent of Analytical Graphics Inc., and is responsible for promotion and sales support of software oriented at modelling of complex inter-related land, sea, air and space systems. The software tools are applicable in design of systems integration, mission planning, mission support and post mission analysis.
